ciRiskDecision: read-heavy-04: Review pull-request CI for supply-chain and privilege escalation paths

exploitPrerequisites.statement: pull_request_target supplies a privileged base-repository token while checkout explicitly runs the contributor head SHA.
actions/checkout uses mutable tag v4 instead of an immutable commit digest.

mitigationLimits: CODEOWNERS review is defense in depth; it does not neutralize execution of an already-open malicious PR.
